newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Ganadero still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Ganadero still a hold.

text.p: ING Barings maintained its hold recommendation on Banco Ganadero, Colombia's largest bank in terms of assets, and voiced concern over the bank's asset quality, in a statement issued Thursday.
ING Barings said the 105 percent gain in first quarter earnings per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) to $0.38 from the previous quarter was still below ING's $0.61 target.
The fourth quarter earnings per ADR of $0.18 were depressed by increased coverage of bank reserves.
ING analysts set a price target of $35.80 for Banco Ganadero common ADRs and $28.50 for its preferred ADRs by December.

Earlier this week, Banco Ganadero reported a 0.8 percent drop in first quarter profits to 14 billion pesos from the year-ago period, blaming higher personnel and general operating costs and an increase in provisions to cover bad debt.

ING said: "We're concerned with the bank's deteriorated asset quality as we do not expect a major improvement in the indicator this year...negative monetary adjustments will continue impacting the stock in the short term."
In New York, Ganadero's common ADR was flat at 34-1/4 and its preferred ADR traded down 3/8 at 27-1/4.
